title: Composition of the normalized coefficient restriction comparison
statement: For composable scheme maps f:S→T and g:T→U, the internal restriction of the specified normalized comparison for f, followed by the comparison for g and encoding of ordinary restriction composition, equals internal restriction composition followed by the normalized comparison for f≫g. The comparison is that constructed in [def-weil-pbc-canonical-finite-discrete-pullback].

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemma 5.4.1; sectionwise coefficient encoding

proof.text: Forget module actions. Expand each comparison using the encoding forget isomorphism. Functoriality cancels the middle inverse and hom. Naturality moves the last inverse past ordinary restriction composition. The underlying internal restriction composition is ordinary additive restriction composition, whose naturality at the initial encoding map gives the result. Reflect equality through the faithful module forgetful functor.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionIso_comp {S T U : Scheme.{u}} (f : S ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ U)
    (N : FiniteDiscreteProEtaleSheaves B S) :
    (lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) g).map
        ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionIso B eR G hG f).hom.app N) ≫
      (finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionIso B eR G hG g).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) f).obj N) ≫
      (finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG U).functor.map
        ((ProEtale.lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) f g).hom.app N) =
    (lowerStarComp (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) f g).hom.app
        ((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG S).functor.obj N) ≫
      (finiteDiscreteCoefficientRestrictionIso B eR G hG (f ≫ g)).hom.app N
